description: Returns cost stats for every hospital with a matching chargemaster entry for a code_type/code. Use this instead of calling get_hospital_chargemaster_cost once per hospital when comparing prices for the same procedure across hospitals (e.g. "which hospital has the cheapest MS-DRG 652?"). Defaults to returning every matching hospital (currently at most a few hundred) in one call. If the response's next_page_token is non-empty, the result set was truncated: call this tool again passing that exact value as page_token to get the next page, and keep doing so until next_page_token is empty - do not stop after one page and conclude a hospital has no data for this code. The response's total_count field (total across all pages) can be compared against how many results you've accumulated so far as a completeness check.

code_type.description: Code system the chargemaster/billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC. Hospitals may also support additional proprietary code types not listed here.

methodology.description: Pricing methodology. Omit to aggregate across all methodologies.

min_sample_count.description: Minimum pricing sample size: only return hospitals whose price is backed by at least this many billing records (compared against the de-identified range's lower bound, so a '1 through 10' row counts as 1). 0 (default) disables the filter. Pass 1 to exclude hospitals with no real sample data at all (most filings report 0/0, indistinguishable from a genuine zero). total_count and next_page_token describe the filtered set. Negative values are rejected.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 500 (covering every matching hospital in one call at the current registry size), capped at 500.

page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous list_hospital_code_costs response's next_page_token field. Omit for the first page. Only valid with the same code_type/code/methodology/min_sample_count it was issued for.

name: list_hospital_code_costs

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token, empty when there are no more results.

results.description: One entry per hospital with a matching chargemaster entry for this code (its latest revision only) - hospitals with no data for this code are omitted, not returned with found=false.

found.description: True if at least one entry in results was found.

hospital.description: Hospital name returned by the MedPrice AI backend.

hospital_id.description: Opaque hospital identifier to use with get_hospital_chargemaster_cost or list_hospitals.

results.description: One entry per requested methodology, in request order - or, when the methodology filter was left empty, exactly one aggregate entry.

sample_count_exact.description: True iff sample_count_sum_min == sample_count_sum_max, i.e. no contributing row was a de-identified '1 through 10' range.

sample_count_sum_max.description: Upper bound on the summed CMS sample-remittance count across contributing payer rows, as a decimal string (int64 - see protoLoaderOptions.longs). Equal to sample_count_sum_min unless a de-identified '1 through 10' row narrowed it to a range.

sample_count_sum_min.description: Lower bound on the summed CMS sample-remittance count across contributing payer rows, as a decimal string (int64 - see protoLoaderOptions.longs). Equal to sample_count_sum_max unless a de-identified '1 through 10' row narrowed it to a range.

found.description: Whether a matching chargemaster cost record was found for this methodology.

methodology.description: Methodology this entry is scoped to. Empty when aggregated across all methodologies (the request's methodology filter was left empty).

total_count.description: Total number of matching results across all pages, not just this page's results.length. Compare against results.length (plus any prior pages) to confirm you have the complete set before concluding a hospital or code has no data.

title: List hospital costs for a billing code
